# 2_extracted_text

The book's text is extracted to the code cache, outside the repo (copyright). This folder keeps only the **sections file** (`<book>.sections.jsonl`): the book's brought-in pages cut into pieces at its own bold headings, each with its section number, title, line ranges, a fingerprint of its words, and the definitions it uses (by the book's italics, R201.1). No words of the book but section titles and defined terms.

**Generated by code only. Never hand-edit.** `python -m document_extraction` reads the brought-in pages (`sources.yaml` `brought_in`) from the cached book, requires them to be the cache's text of the whole book at those pages (reading the whole book into the cache again where they are not, once per extractor version: `document_extraction/book_text.py`), and writes this file here; `--check` writes nothing and fails if either differs from a fresh extraction. Where the cache is missing (CI), it is skipped and says so. How it reads stacked fractions, and how it cuts: `packages/document_extraction/document_extraction/icc.py` and `icc_sections.py`.
